text:
pagerbot: 🔔 INCIDENT P0 - Rollout instability detected: canary 'redwood-alpha-2' returning elevated 5xx in us-west-2. Auto-fallbacks kicking but sticky affinity appears to be routing to inconsistent regions -> request oscillation. Paging @maria-ml (oncall) and SRE. Incident opened at 2024-06-12T09:04:36Z

maria-ml: oncall here, looking now. canceling any non-essential deploys.

sam-sre: pulling metrics/logs. in the last 5m canary error rate ~18% (502/503), p50 latency up 2x. traffic split was 10% to redwood-alpha-2.

lee-platform: quick note — sticky fallback is handled by routing policy r-routing-v3; TTL supposed to be 300s. if sticky binds to a different region (sticky->eu vs canary->us) you can get repeated cross-region fallbacks.

support_tier1: customers reporting: 
- Acme Corp (enterprise) experiencing generation errors and timeouts since 09:02 UTC
- playground-alpha users seeing timeouts in us-west region

deploy-bot: Canary rollout rl-2026-0412-01 started at 09:00 UTC -> redwood-alpha-2 (10%). No automatic rollback triggered by deploy system yet.

sam-sre: I recommend: 1) pause the rollout, 2) reduce sticky TTL to limit oscillation, 3) set fallback preference to same-region if available.

maria-ml: executing actions. pausing rollout now.
```bash
# pause rollout
redwood rollout pause --id=rl-2026-0412-01
# verify
redwood rollout status --id=rl-2026-0412-01
```

deploy-bot: rollback command available. rollout paused -> traffic hold at 10% until manual drain.

maria-ml: updating routing policy to shorter sticky TTL and prefer same-region fallbacks. applying change.
```bash
rctl policy update r-routing-v3 --sticky-ttl 60 --fallback-preference same-region
rctl policy get r-routing-v3
```

lee-platform: seeing lots of cross-region sticky sessions in the logs: requests from us-west client get routed to redwood-alpha-2 in us-west, fail, then fallback sticky picks stable in eu-west, then subsequent requests get routed back to us-west canary because session affinity still resolves differently -> repeated cold starts. KV cache thrash + higher latency.

sam-sre: I'm starting a forced drain of canary traffic to 0% and initiating rollback to stable variant.
```bash
redwood rollout update --id=rl-2026-0412-01 --traffic 0
redwood rollout rollback --id=rl-2026-0412-01 --to redwood-stable-v1
```

support_tier1: Acme notified by CS. Raised ticket INC-2481 and assigned to customer success.

pagerbot: Automated metric update: global error rate lowered from 12% -> 1.1% within 3 minutes of rollback. p50 latency trending back to baseline.

ops_lead: good. keep eyes on region-specific metrics for 30m. action items: 
- Add automated check during rollouts to validate fallback region alignment (lee/platform)
- Add canary health probe threshold to auto-abort earlier (maria-ml)
- Add sticky-ttl sanity check in policy deploy pipeline (sam-sre)

maria-ml: filing incident ticket and assigning owners. Ticket: INC-2481. I'll own the postmortem.

deploy-bot: Patch PR created to prefer same-region fallbacks when available: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/1127 (patch includes TTL guardrails). Hotfix scheduled for tomorrow's window.

sam-sre: handing off monitoring to lee-platform for the remainder of the shift. I'll update runbook with steps we used here.

lee-platform: acknowledged. I'll watch for any late regressions and validate that sticky-ttl change stopped oscillation.

maria-ml: incident mitigated and rollout halted at 09:11 UTC. Summarizing customer impact: Acme had partial failures for ~9 minutes, some developer sandbox users saw transient timeouts. No data loss.

ops_lead: closing paging loop. postmortem due EOD tomorrow. assign severity P1-> root cause: canary variant producing 5xx under specific prompt patterns + routing policy allowed cross-region sticky fallback oscillation.

pagerbot: Incident closed by maria-ml at 09:20 UTC. Follow-up: postmortem link will be posted here when ready. :white_check_mark:
